title: Closing: children's birthplaces and contact address
summary: Wilson lists where his five children were born and gives a post office box for the tape.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Talking about my children and grandchildren

blocks.x: Uh huh. Well, I can't think of anything else except that this has been one of the nicest interviews I've ever had with anybody, and to talk with someone as knowledgeable as you are is really something. And your two children -- and there are five children, though, yes?

Five all together. Yes. I didn't mention earlier, James and June were born in Westwood, New Jersey, where the hospital is, and of course our home there is in Hillsdale, New Jersey, and Steven was born in New York City, over at Mt. Sinai Hospital, and Ted was born in New York City, too.
And Bill was born in Cleveland, because he was my wife's boy before I met her.
Uh huh. Could you just give us
Just say it on the air, so I have it on the tape.
To reach me now is P.O. Box 580 in Westwood, New Jersey 07675.
